annotations.title: Fortress Shield: restore placeholders (free, on this Worker)

description:
WHAT: Fortress Shield (agent I/O PII protection). Put the original values back into texts (typically an LLM answer) that contain placeholders such as [EMAIL_k7q2m9xp4a], by opening meta.sealed_map from pii_redact_text on this Worker (or a legacy clear-text placeholder map).
WHEN: After an LLM or third party answered a prompt you sanitized with pii_redact_text (redactionStyle "placeholder"), right before showing the answer to the user.
WHEN NOT: To redact (pii_redact_text) or find PII (pii_scan_text). Masked and hashed values cannot be restored; only placeholder style is reversible.
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One "restored_document" row per text with restored, output_text, replacements, fuzzy_restored, unknown_placeholders and near_miss_placeholders. meta.restore_gate is RESTORE_KEY_OK, or RESTORE_KEY_REQUIRED / RESTORE_KEY_MISMATCH / RESTORE_LIMIT_REACHED, in which case nothing is substituted: restored is false, replacements 0, output_text is the input unchanged and sealed_replacements_withheld only counts them. restored is true only when at least one placeholder was actually replaced. Every row carries map_source ("sealed" | "plaintext"), verified (true only for an authenticated sealed map) and exact (no fuzzy, unknown or near-miss placeholders); meta.verification and meta.audit (counts) summarise them. A clear-text placeholderMap alone is refused on deployments with a seal key (meta.restore_gate SEALED_MAP_REQUIRED, nothing substituted, plaintext_replacements_refused counts). Further gate codes (counts only): TENANT_MISMATCH (map bound to another tenantId), USER_ONLY_RESTORE (restoreAudience "user" without the X-FQ-PII-User-Present header), APPS_RESTORE_REQUIRED (operator requires a user-facing MCP Apps / UI restore). meta.seal_ttl {expires_at, remaining_seconds}; meta.sealed_map_extended with extendTtlHours; meta.receipt with returnReceipt. Errors: INPUT_TOO_LARGE, MAP_MISSING, SEALED_MAP_INVALID (altered or from another deployment), SEALED_MAP_EXPIRED, SEAL_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED.
BEHAVIOR: Original values come back only when the request carries the same restore key header (X-FQ-PII-Restore-Key, configured by the operator in the MCP client connection, never a tool argument) that was present when the map was sealed, and at most maxRestores times per map; otherwise counts only. Holding the sealed map alone is not enough. Runs on this Fairquery-hosted Worker (Cloudflare), not on the caller's machine; inputs leave the client. This Worker's code is designed not to store inputs, results, or an Apify token. No further network call; the map is not forwarded. Milliseconds. Max 50 texts, 200,000 chars each, 500,000 total; map up to 10,000 entries.
PARAMETERS: sealedMap: pass meta.sealed_map unchanged (preferred). placeholderMap: legacy clear-text map, honoured only when this deployment has no seal key (or the operator restore policy is "open"), and then marked verified false; if both are given, sealedMap is used alone and placeholderMap is ignored (never merged; PLAINTEXT_MAP_IGNORED note). Every key is replaced wherever it occurs exactly (longest first, one pass, so a restored value is never replaced again). fuzzyRestore (default true): a placeholder the LLM rewrote but whose random id is intact ("EMAIL_k7q2m9xp4a" without brackets, lower case, a space instead of _) is restored too and listed in fuzzy_restored. unknown_placeholders lists exact [TYPE_N] shapes the map does not contain; near_miss_placeholders lists mangled shapes ("EMAIL_3", "[Email_4]") that matched no key; both stay as they are. When restored is true the output contains the ORIGINAL sensitive values: show it to the user, do not send it back to the LLM. limit/offset page whole documents (default 10 per page).
EXAMPLE: {"texts":["I will email [EMAIL_t7c3pz2wqa] today."],"sealedMap":"fqs2.…"} with the restore key header -> output_text "I will email jane@acme.com today.", replacements 1; without it -> restored false, sealed_replacements_withheld 1.

extendTtlHours.description: Optional integer 1-720. After an allowed restore, also return meta.sealed_map_extended: the same map (same id, restore count, bindings) re-sealed to expire this many hours from now. Refused (EXTEND_TTL_REFUSED note) when the restore gate refused.

fuzzyRestore.description: Optional boolean, default true. Also restore rewritten placeholders whose random id is intact; false = exact keys only.

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-50 (default 10). Example: 10

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

placeholderMap.description: Optional, legacy (this or sealedMap required). Object placeholder -> original value, as returned in meta.placeholder_map (deprecated) or placeholder_map by pii_guard_documents; keys 1-200 chars, values <= 10,000 chars, <= 10,000 entries. Example: {"[EMAIL_1]":"jane@acme.com"}

receiptTtlDays.description: Optional integer 1-3650, default 30. Restore-receipt validity in days from now.

restoreAudience.description: Optional, "any" | "user", default "any". "user" = this restore is for the user only: originals come back only with the X-FQ-PII-User-Present header (MCP Apps / client UI), else USER_ONLY_RESTORE, counts only.

returnReceipt.description: Optional, default false. true adds meta.receipt, an fqrc2 Ed25519 JWS {map id, restores used, documents, replacements} with an HMAC commitment of these input texts (not an unsalted sha256), detector version, and exp. The restored text is not hashed, because it contains the original values. Default expiry is 30 days (receiptTtlDays). No values; verify with pii_verify_receipt.

sealedMap.description: Optional (this or placeholderMap required). meta.sealed_map from pii_redact_text, unchanged. Example: "fqs2.…"

tenantId.description: Optional. Tenant of a tenant-bound sealed_map (pii_redact_text tenantId); a different or missing tenant -> TENANT_MISMATCH, counts only. The X-FQ-PII-Tenant header wins.

texts.description: Required. 1-50 documents (prompt, chat message, log, file content), each <= 200,000 chars, total <= 500,000 chars. Example: ["Mail jane@acme.com, key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"]

name: pii_restore_text

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Fortress Shield: restore placeholders with original values (free, on this Worker)
